t: Get started menu: Welcome to ShankhNaad.
ShankhNaad is your smart office workspace: chat, calls, meetings, files, your team and work, in one place.
In this video, you will learn how to sign in, find your way around the screen, choose a theme, and install the desktop app.
Open your company's ShankhNaad address in Chrome or Edge. Type your work email.
Then type your password, and press Sign in.
Forgot your password? Press Forgot password on the sign-in page, and ShankhNaad emails you a link to set a new one.
Every page has the same frame. On the left is the menu: Chat, Calls, Files, Meetings, Team, Work, Org and Help.
At the top are quick links to the same pages, and on the right, your connection, the clock and your name.
Below them is the page itself, with its own buttons in the header.
To change the look, press the Theme button and pick Kesari, Light, Dark or CloudWheel.
Kesari uses saffron, white and green.
And CloudWheel is the deep blue night you have seen so far.
To use ShankhNaad in its own window, open your profile menu and choose Install desktop app.
Press Install app and confirm. Calls then ring on your desktop, even when the browser is closed.
